verdict.rationale: Neon is a database platform, not an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. The evidence clearly delivers it. First-party docs describe a hosted official MCP server at mcp.neon.tech/mcp using Streamable HTTP, with a 113-tool surface and read-only, category and project scoping. The `neon mcp` command installs it into named agents. Independent runtime probes confirmed the endpoint is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow, and that the keyless list-tools endpoint returns the scoped tool lists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect MCP clients to the Neon MCP Server to interact with your Lakebase Postgres databases in natural language.
The `mcp` command installs the Neon MCP Server into your coding agents by writing their MCP config for you.
The hosted Neon MCP Server uses Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.neon.tech/mcp`.
a live, OAuth-gated remote MCP server per the MCP authorization spec.
returns HTTP 200 keylessly with {"grant": {"projectId": null, "scopes": ["querying"]}, "readOnly": true}
